body.statement: Dörfler et al.'s numerical edge-identifiability reduction constructs a rational positive-definite feasible covariance \(\Sigma\) for an acyclic mixed graph \(G\) such that the coefficient fiber \(\mathcal F_G(\Sigma)\) is isomorphic to the source real solution set and the distinguished edge equals the distinguished source coordinate.  Their construction stores all source coordinates as incoming coefficients of one shared sink, so that sink's directed fan-in grows with the source dimension.

source.locator: Section 4, especially Figure 3, Observation 4, and the proof of Theorem 2; Appendix A.1, proof of Corollary 4
source.verbatim_statement: the fiber \(F_G(\Sigma)\) is isomorphic to the solutions our \(\mathrm{QUAD}^{++}\)-instance.

attestation.note: Transcribed from the official NeurIPS 2024 proceedings PDF, Section 4 and Appendix A.1, accessed 2026-09-13; the storage-sink description is taken from Figure 3 and the adjacent construction text.
